name: Sunsword

source.note: A Tarokka treasure (data/tarokka). Curse of Strahd's 2016 numbers as we know them, in our own words; check against the book.

powers.name: Widen or narrow the sunlight
powers.text: Bonus Action: the blade's sunlight grows or shrinks 5 ft at a time (bright 10 to 30 ft, as far again dim).

sentience.purpose: to see Strahd and every vampire destroyed

summary: Sergei's sword: a hilt that grows a blade of sunlight. +2, Finesse, Radiant; an extra 1d8 Radiant against Undead; it sheds true sunlight.
text: A platinum hilt with a sunburst guard and no blade, until someone attuned to it wills one: then a blade of pure sunlight springs from it. It fights as a +2 longsword with Finesse that deals Radiant damage, and an extra 1d8 Radiant to Undead. The blade sheds sunlight, bright for 15 feet and dim for 15 more; a Bonus Action widens or narrows the glow by 5 feet, up to 30 feet bright. The sword thinks and speaks into its bearer's mind. It loathes the undead, wants Strahd ended above all, and has no patience for a bearer who runs from him.
